ops.body: Design reviewed and approved by the user (round-5 session, 2026-07-05). Decisions: (1) presence-union — a signal counts once toward the threshold no matter how many window entries it matches; scoring stays per-entry-then-union, never concatenated. (2) Window-scoped suppression expressed as a FIRST-CLASS veto mechanism (user: 'add a proper primitive for this') — new vetoes field on Signals; any veto match anywhere in the window suppresses the fire; migrate steering.py's negative-weight patterns (-3/-4, and disposition the -2 dampers) to vetoes and retire negative weights. (3) Consumed hashes: all contributing entries on an aggregate fire. Unchanged: dual commit points (eager consume in nudge/gate, revert-then-consume-on-verdict in llm primitives), window/UPS mechanics, match_signals return contract. Blast radius: 6 signal-scored hooks (show wall_of_text + 5 captain-hook packs); cc-notes/cc-context declare no Signals. Ships as 8.6.0.
